title: Le Voyage dans la Lune
evidence: Inherited approved asset; Commons description identifies poster for 1902 film. Original theatrical printing is not independently established; do not label original release.

title: Человек с киноаппаратом
evidence: Commons film description, 1929 date, Vertov artist and Anthology Film Archives still reference agree.

title: Cleopatra
evidence: Inherited reviewed poster. Commons explicitly identifies Cleopatra (1917 film), Theda Bara and expired-US copyright; not the 1963 remake.

title: London After Midnight
evidence: Commons describes 1927 American mystery film; MGM creator, dated original one-sheet auction source and Lon Chaney depiction corroborate.

title: পথের পাঁচালী
evidence: Commons category Pather Panchali (1955), 1955 date, artist Satyajit Ray/Government of West Bengal, named cast; MoMA collection item 301157 source. File lists PD-URAA, unlike other Pather Panchali files flagged copyrighted in the US.

title: Meshes of the Afternoon
evidence: File explicitly describes still from experimental 1943 short by Maya Deren, category Meshes of the Afternoon and date 1943; PD US no notice statement. Co-director credit retained from catalogue.

title: 小城之春
file: Spring in a Small Town poster.jpg
evidence: Commons claims 1948 Chinese poster, but downloaded image inspection shows Korean lettering and a composite cover layout. Later release/version/cover rights are not established. Withheld pending edition review; not counted as genuine theatrical artwork.

title: La hora de los hornos
file: Afiche de La hora de los hornos.jpg
evidence: 1968 original date, description identifies Argentine political film by Grupo de Cine Liberacion, Cedinci collection source. File rights state PD-AR-Anonymous and PD US no notice.

title: Daughters of the Dust
file: Pamela Ferrell on set Film Daughters of the Dust in 1989.png
evidence: Description explicitly identifies the 1991 American film and 1989 filming on Saint Helena Island; Julie Dash category, photo donated by Pamela Ferrell and family under CC BY-SA 4.0. Label as production photograph, never a poster or frame.
